source.author: Nial Fuller
source.title: Inside Bar Forex Trading Strategy
verified_sections: How to trade the inside bar setup
The best time frame for trading inside bars
source.original_timeframe: Daily preferred;4h lowest considered by author
source.adverse_source_evidence: Author explicitly discourages lower timeframes and discusses failed1h examples. This15m/1h transfer is an unproven internal hypothesis.
supported_concepts: Strict inside bar within mother high/low
Opposite mother extreme as stop reference

rules.context: At mother open, use the latest3 consecutive complete UTC1h bars ending at floor(mother_open/1h)*1h; each high,low,close strictly rises across the3 bars. Context is latched for that one setup.
rules.hour_aggregation: Exactly4 consecutive aligned15m bars of one segment, all available by own close; hourly available=max constituent available. No partial hour, interpolation or forward-fill.
rules.setup: Immediate preceding15m mother and current15m strictly-inside bar (high<mother.high and low>mother.low); mother close>mother open; required3-hour context exists before mother opens.
rules.trigger: Within next4 completed15m bars after inside, first close>frozen mother high, provided every intervening low>mother low. A low<=mother low cancels before evaluating recovery.
rules.entry: Next contiguous15m open after trigger close; future open is not used to generate signal. Reject entry<=mother low.
rules.initial_stop: Frozen mother low, no pip/tick padding (explicit adaptation; tick metadata not needed).
rules.profit_exit: Resting2R target based on actual next-open fill and initial risk; existing engine stop-first if target and stop occur together.
rules.time_exit: After16 held15m bars, exit next contiguous open; missing next bar stays unresolved, no terminal synthetic close.
rules.other_exit: None; fixed initial stop, no trailing, partial, breakeven or late rearm.
rules.reentry: Each consumed/cancelled mother expires; new later mother/inside pair required. One emitted event per setup; engine handles duplicate event and occupancy.
rules.gaps: Any missing15m interval,segment change or delayed observation resets setup and hour context. Invalid OHLC/duplicate timestamps fail; empty valid frames return0 signals.

parameter_provenance: Single predeclared development design, not fitted, source-original, SSOT risk threshold or promotion gate.

costs.semantics: Frozen reference round-trip cost debit;1x/2x same fills; actual historical funding/slippage not newly verified.

difference: Compared with Rider impulse/lower-low pullback/reclaim and Squeeze optional inside pause/second reclaim, this uses independently completed3-hour price structure latched before mother, one strict15m mother-inside expansion, fixed mother stop and2R/16bar exit without EMA,ADX,squeeze,panic or second-attempt grammar.
